title: NSN 6685006181822/Nomenclature: Indicator, Humidity
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEFENSE LOGISTICS AGENCY.DLA AVIATION.DLA AV RICHMOND.DEFENSE LOGISTICS AGENCY
detail_text: NAICS: 334519 This agency proposes to issue a solicitation for a long-term strategic contract for NSNs 6685-00-618-1822. The proposed contract will be an indefinite delivery indefinite quantity fixed price contract utilizing FAR part 15. The proposed contract has a potential five-year duration with a five-year base period. Letters expressing interest in subcontracting provided to the contracting officer will be forwarded to the identified awardee. Best value selection methods will be used. The solicitation will be posted on SAM.gov and DIBBs on or around May 19, 2026.
